description: Create a simulated medical device adapter in OpenICE. In the OpenICE Supervisor application, click on 'Create an ICE Device Adapter' button to open the device creation dialog. Select 'Simulated' as the Device Category, then select 'Multiparameter Monitor' as the Device Type (this simulates a patient monitor showing vital signs like heart rate, blood pressure, SpO2). Click the 'Start' button to create the device adapter. The simulated device should appear in the 'Devices' panel on the right side of the screen, showing real-time vital sign data.
